stances.name: Offensive Stance
stances.blurb: +15% Damage and +10% Attack Speed. You take 10% more damage.

stances.name: Defensive Stance
stances.blurb: +20% Plating and 10% less damage taken. -15% Damage.

stances.name: Tanking Stance
stances.blurb: +40% Plating and 25% less damage taken. -40% Damage and -20% Attack Speed.

stances.name: Enraged Stance
stances.blurb: While at or below 25% HP: +30% Damage and +15% Attack Speed.

stances.name: Perfection Stance
stances.blurb: +12% Damage, Attack Speed, and Movement Speed while at or above 90% HP. -20% Plating at all times.

behaviors.label: Bonuses require
behaviors.help: Damage, Attack Speed and Movement Speed are granted only while your HP is at or above 90% of maximum. Cross the line in either direction and they turn off or back on within a tick.

behaviors.label: Plating penalty
behaviors.help: The -20% Plating is paid whenever the stance is active, including below 90% HP where the bonuses are off. Once you drop, Perfection is strictly worse than no stance at all — leave it.

stances.name: Fleeting Stance
stances.blurb: +35% Movement Speed and +15% Evasion. -35% Damage and -20% Attack Speed.

stances.name: Berserker Stance
stances.blurb: +35% Damage and +20% Attack Speed. You take 15% more damage and lose 2% of max HP each second while in combat — this can kill you.

behaviors.label: Self-damage
behaviors.help: Direct damage dealt to you every second that combat state persists. It bypasses plating, damage reduction, barriers and cheat-death, and it will kill you if you hold the stance too long.

stances.name: Recuperating Stance
stances.blurb: 80% of your Recovery stays active in combat. -50% Damage and -30% Attack Speed.

stances.name: Predator Stance
stances.blurb: 50% reduced enemy detection and +15% Movement Speed. Your first hit after approaching out of combat deals 75% more damage. -10% Damage.

behaviors.label: Enemy detection
behaviors.help: Every monster's effective detection radius is halved while the stance is active, so you can cross a node without pulling it.

behaviors.label: Opening hit
behaviors.help: The opener arms while Predator is active and you are out of combat, and is consumed by your first hit on a monster. Re-arms once combat ends.

stances.name: Brawler Stance
stances.blurb: -10% Damage. Gain damage reduction for each enemy actively engaging you, from 8% against one attacker up to 40% against five or more.

behaviors.label: Crowd mitigation
behaviors.help: Incoming damage is reduced by 8% / 16% / 24% / 31% / 40% against 1 / 2 / 3 / 4 / 5+ monsters currently aggroed onto you. Capped at 40%.

stances.name: Execute Stance
stances.blurb: -20% Damage. Deal 75% more damage to targets at or below 25% HP.

behaviors.label: Finisher
behaviors.help: Applies to every hit on a target already at or below the threshold. It does not trigger on the hit that brings them there.

stances.name: Time to Strike
stances.blurb: +100% empowered-attack damage. Ordinary hits deal 40% less damage and you attack 35% slower.

behaviors.label: Empowered damage
behaviors.help: Added to your empowered-attack multiplier, whatever your class's empowered attack is — a finisher, a cooldown burst, a full-energy discharge or a loaded shot.

behaviors.label: Ordinary hits
behaviors.help: Every hit that is NOT empowered is reduced by this much, on top of the attack-speed penalty. The posture is only worth holding around an empowered attack.

stances.name: Reaper Stance
stances.blurb: -15% Damage. Killing an enemy grants +35% Damage and +25% Attack Speed for 6s, and the momentum keeps running after you leave the stance.

behaviors.label: Kill momentum
behaviors.help: Armed by any kill you land while Reaper is active. It PERSISTS after you leave the stance, so the intended loop is: enter Reaper for the finish, kill, revert to your default posture, and spend the momentum on the next enemy. Further kills refresh the window only while Reaper is active again — the duration resets, it never stacks higher.

stances.name: Warding Stance
stances.blurb: Incoming harmful effects last 50% less and enemy damage-over-time hits 40% weaker. -50% Damage and -25% Attack Speed.

behaviors.label: Endure, not cleanse
behaviors.help: Warding scales what lands rather than deleting it, so it answers layered pressure a single cleanse cannot keep up with. Effects already on you when you enter keep the duration they were given — this applies at the moment a new one is applied.

stances.name: Powering Up
stances.blurb: A weak posture that charges while you fight, up to 8s. Leaving it spends the charge for +50% Damage and +30% Attack Speed, lasting as long as you charged. -50% Damage and -30% Attack Speed while charging.

behaviors.label: Charge
behaviors.help: Charge accrues only while the stance is active AND you are in combat, and it is cleared when combat ends. You cannot charge before a pull and arrive loaded.

behaviors.label: Release
behaviors.detail: for as long as you charged
behaviors.help: Spent automatically the moment you leave the stance, however you leave it. Charge below 1s is discarded rather than paid out. Pair it with the "Stance Charged" Rune situation to leave at full charge on its own.

actions.name: Avoid Enemies

actions.name: Switch Stance
